name: APIVerveTextStyler
summary: Text Styler converts plain text into styled text formats like bubble letters, strikethrough, typewriter, and vaporwave.
description:
Text Styler converts plain text into styled text formats like bubble letters, strikethrough, typewriter, and vaporwave. Submit your string with a chosen style to receive the formatted text output.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Text Styler from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
